summary: Lumbar MRI after a failed 6-week PT trial, surgeon planning an injection

request.clinical_notes:
Patient: Daniel Okafor. DOB 04/12/1974. MRN 00482913. Phone (415) 555-0142.
52-year-old warehouse supervisor seen for low back pain radiating down the left leg, onset about 9 weeks ago after lifting boxes. He completed 6 weeks of supervised physical therapy (12 sessions) and took naproxen 500 mg twice daily during that period, with no meaningful improvement. Pain is 7/10 and worse with sitting. Exam: positive straight leg raise on the left at 40 degrees, decreased sensation over the dorsum of the left foot, strength 5/5 throughout, reflexes symmetric. No bowel or bladder changes, no fever, no weight loss, no history of cancer. Referred to spine surgery; Dr. Hamid plans a lumbar epidural steroid injection and needs MRI to choose the level.
